note: Every numeric threshold below is a configurable demonstration threshold chosen for this prototype. None are official MPLAD/government-mandated figures. See docs/DETECTION_RULES_SOURCE.md for full traceability to ANAMOLIES.txt.

rules.name: Progress vs Time Elapsed
rules.description: Compares the percentage of sanctioned project duration elapsed against the percentage of physical work actually completed. A large gap suggests the project is at risk of missing its scheduled completion timeline.

rules.name: Milestone Slippage
rules.description: Flags milestones whose expected date has passed while actual progress on that milestone remains below its expected progress.

rules.name: Cost-Progress Mismatch
rules.description: Compares the percentage of sanctioned funds spent against physical progress achieved. A large positive gap (money spent far exceeding work done) is a strong indicator warranting financial review.

rules.name: Budget Overrun Pace
rules.description: Flags projects where spent amount as a share of sanctioned amount is disproportionate to elapsed time, indicating the budget is being consumed faster than the schedule warrants.

rules.name: Expenditure Missing Justification
rules.description: An expenditure entry above the configured amount threshold lacks a justification note or a supporting document reference.
rules.metric: amount > amountThreshold AND (justification is empty OR documentIds is empty)

rules.name: Duplicate or Inflated Invoice
rules.description: Detects duplicate invoice numbers or duplicate document hashes across expenditures/documents, or amounts on a document that don't match the linked expenditure entry.
rules.metric: duplicateCount(invoiceNumber OR documentHash) OR amountMismatch(document.amount, expenditure.amount)

rules.name: Reported Work Without Evidence Corroboration
rules.description: A progress submission reports a jump in physical progress without any accompanying evidence (photo/GPS/activity update) in a reasonable window.

rules.name: Location Mismatch
rules.description: Distance between submitted evidence GPS coordinates and the registered project location exceeds the configured tolerance.
rules.source: conditions-file:Work Anomaly Detection / Scheduled Site Attendance Monitoring

rules.name: Implausible Evidence Timestamp
rules.description: Evidence timestamp falls outside the project's start/end window, or is dated after the submission time (impossible chronology).

rules.name: Image Reuse / High Similarity
rules.description: Perceptual hash similarity between newly uploaded evidence and previously stored evidence (same project or another project) exceeds the configured similarity threshold, suggesting potential evidence reuse. This does not by itself mean the image is fake.

rules.name: Plan vs Actual Construction Deviation
rules.description: Reported work items/quantity deviate from the approved work scope recorded in the sanction, indicating the on-site construction may not match what was sanctioned.

rules.name: Quality Concern Flag
rules.description: Evidence marked INVALID/SUSPICIOUS by the CV validation pipeline, or explicitly flagged by an officer during a site visit, is aggregated as a quality concern. This is not an automated material-science quality test.

rules.name: Quantity Deviation
rules.description: Reported/observed quantity of material or completed work deviates from the sanctioned approved quantity by more than the configured percentage.

rules.name: Sanction Report Deviation
rules.description: Project activity, expenditure, or timeline deviates from what was recorded in the approved sanction (amount released beyond sanctioned amount, work outside approved scope, or timeline extended without an approved exception).
rules.metric: spentAmount > sanctionedAmount OR releasedAmount > sanctionedAmount OR today > endDate without approved exception

rules.name: Condition Non-Compliance
rules.description: One or more explicitly defined project Conditions (financial/timeline/work/evidence/visit/other) are marked as not satisfied against their expected value/operator/threshold.

rules.name: Site Visit Compliance Violation
rules.description: Number of GPS-verified site visits actually recorded is below the number required, net of any officer-approved exceptions.

rules.name: Repeated Contractor Anomaly Pattern
rules.description: A contractor's anomaly rate across all their assigned projects (open findings / total findings evaluated) exceeds the configured threshold, suggesting a systemic pattern rather than an isolated incident.
rules.source: conditions-file:derived from Cost/Work Anomaly Detection + Scheduled Site Attendance Monitoring

rules.name: Document Inconsistency
rules.description: Invoice/report amount recorded in a Document does not match the linked Expenditure amount, or a required supporting document for an expenditure/condition is missing.
rules.metric: abs(document.amount - expenditure.amount) OR documentIds.length == 0 when required
rules.source: conditions-file:Cost Anomaly Detection (inflated invoices) / Condition Compliance Monitoring
